title: gated-dag Configuration
description: Gated-DAG dispatch executor (ADR-046 Phase 2): dispatches DAG units in dependency order with restart recovery, failure isolation, and stall detection.

backstop_interval.description: Period of the unconditional re-eval tick that closes the missed-watch-event hole and surfaces stalls.

claim_predicate.description: Triple predicate carrying the durable in-flight claim (the dedup record committed before dispatch).

completed_predicate.description: Triple predicate marking a unit complete.

depends_on_predicate.description: Triple predicate carrying a unit's prerequisite unit IDs (multi-valued; one triple per edge).

dirtied_predicate.description: Triple predicate marking a unit reset/dirtied (re-derives Ready over any stale terminal marker).

dispatch_subject.description: Subject published with the unit entity ID reference when a unit is dispatchable. The consumer wires its handler here. Required.

failed_predicate.description: Triple predicate marking a unit failed.

failure_policy.description: How a failed unit affects new dispatch.

fan_out_workflow.description: lifecycle.Workflow.Name watched for re-eval triggers. Defaults to the framework FanOut workflow (self-registered).

max_units.description: Cap on the authoritative whole-set read; a larger fan-out logs a truncation warning.

query_timeout.description: Timeout bounding each authoritative graph.query.prefix read.

unit_entity_prefix.description: graph.query.prefix scope read authoritatively each evaluation — the blast radius of one fan-out. Required.
